name: jobs
summary: Lists the jobs started from the current shell.
description: Shell builtin that shows the session’s jobs: those started in the background with &, or suspended with Ctrl+Z. Each job has a number ([1], [2]…) that can be used with fg, bg or kill as %1. The + marks the current job, the - the previous one.

options.description: Adds the PID of each job.
Only jobs whose state has changed since they were last shown.

examples.explanation: The same list with the PID of each job.
Stops every job in the session: jobs -p gives the PIDs, xargs passes them to kill.
